source_title: Built To Last® Season 10 Premieres on Halloween Day in TV markets across the Midwest
source_excerpt:
Award-Winning TV Show Features Union Construction Projects Happening Across Illinois, Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska and Iowa
CHICAGO , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Built To LastÂ® is kicking off another season of television showcasing exciting and impactful union construction projects happening across the Midwest at large.
Starting with the name itself, Built To LastÂ® means enduring quality, and spotlights how the Mid-America Carpenters Union sets the benchmark for performance, training, safety and industry-leading productivity, making it the smart choice for creating partnerships. Built To LastÂ® showcases construction projects and fascinating individuals that collectively exemplify the real-world contributions that organized labor makes in our communities. The program also showcases public and private economic developments and partnerships, as well as the Carpenters Union's dedication to the building industry.
Watching Built To LastÂ® this season, you will learn how construction projects go from an idea to reality and along the way you will hear stories from the Union Carpenters, stakeholders and community leaders making it all happen.
You can catch up on previous seasons of the program on builttolasttv.com . Episodes from season 10 will be uploaded online as they air on TV. Stay up to date with the season by following Built To LastÂ® on social media channels @BuiltToLastTV on Facebook and @Built2LastTV on YouTube.
About the Mid-America Carpenters Regional Council The Mid-America Carpenters Regional Council represents more than 57,000 working men and women across Missouri, Kansas, Illinois, Iowa and Nebraska. We provide the construction and maintenance industries with productive, competitive and certified professionals, encompassing a wide variety of crafts and skills.
